problem: Investment teams need research, portfolio analysis, risk and client servicing workflows that generic AI tools do not handle reliably; InferEdge builds custom agentic workflows inside the client's cloud.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AlphaSense absorbed Sentieo in 2022 and later Tegus in 2024, showing incumbents acquire in this space; InferEdge was still operating in 2026.
